meta.name: to-spec
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker — no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把讨论内容自动整理成需求文档并提交到项目跟踪系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你们在讨论中确定了需求，需要快速生成规范文档并同步到项目管理系统
copy.tagline_en: Turn your conversation into a spec and publish it to the project tracker
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn discussions into structured specs and push them to your issue tracker

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把当前对话内容自动整理成一份产品需求文档（PRD），并发布到项目的 issue 跟踪器中，无需你额外填写。
howto.when: 当你和 Claude 讨论完一个功能需求，希望它直接输出正式规格文档时触发。

say.text: 把刚才讨论的登录功能写成 spec 发到 issue 里。
say.note: Claude 会生成 PRD 并创建 issue。

say.text: 根据我们聊的搜索优化，出一份 spec 并发布。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically synthesizes the current conversation into a product requirements document (PRD) and publishes it to the project's issue tracker without requiring further input.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have discussed a feature with Claude and want it to produce a formal spec document.

say_en.text: Turn the login feature we just discussed into a spec and post it as an issue.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the PRD and create the issue.

say_en.text: Based on our chat about search optimization, produce a spec and publish it.
say_en.note: Claude will synthesize the document and apply the ready-for-agent label.
